releaseNotes:
Release v0.20.0

New Features:
- Add solution tools view and graph parameter deployment
- Add combinatorics data nodes (PS-264)

Bug Fixes:
- Preserve solution tool state and compatibility
- Organize large solution tool selectors
- Align tool view navigation and styling with the editor
- Harden license recovery ordering and cancellation (PS-265)
- Recover paid feature access after license failures (PS-265)
- Refresh combinatorics documentation (PS-264)
- Remove vulnerable optional S3 and mail dependencies (PS-263)

Improvements:
- Dependency updates: firebase 13.1.0, meshopt 0.7, httpmock 0.9, vite 8.3.5, esbuild 0.28.2
